config.architecture: factor-structured Riccati PINN; NOT regular price-PDE architecture
config.lr_schedule: cosine from lr to .02*lr across declared steps
config.selection: independent factor-coefficient validation RMSE; not parameter recovery
config.data_policy: independent synthetic factor-state coefficients; no calibration-case inputs

sampling: LHS, half log-frequency and half 128-node Laguerre frequencies; independent split seeds
collocation_note: 18000 is a fixed factor-state/frequency pool, not regular four-dimensional price collocation
